title: Measurement of Trustworthiness of the Online Reviews
abstract: arXiv:2210.00815v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Online review platforms shape consumer decisions, yet reported ratings and comments may be unreliable when reviewers behave inconsistently. This paper models online reviews as a sequential choice problem and proposes a formal rationality pattern function that links a reviewer's current review to their revealed preference history. Building on a two-way consistency axiom for choices from nested sets, we derive an object-specific support trajectory and an associated degree measure in [0,1] (Average Propensity to Choose a Pattern, APCP) that quantifies review trustworthiness. The measure is designed to support information updating and reduce asymmetric information by discounting reviews that are inconsistent with past behavior. A worked example illustrates how the approach assigns trustworthiness grades to reviews for different objects and how these grades can complement aggregate rating statistics. translated_title: 在线评论可信度的度量
translated_abstract: 在线评论平台影响着消费者的决策，然而当评论者行为不一致时，其所发布的评分和评论可能并不可靠。本文将在线评论建模为一个序贯选择问题，并提出了一种形式化的理性模式函数，将评论者当前的评论与其显示偏好历史联系起来。基于嵌套集合选择的双向一致性公理，我们推导出一个针对特定对象的支持轨迹以及一个取值于[0,1]区间的关联程度度量（选择模式的平均倾向，APCP），用以量化评论的可信度。该度量旨在支持信息更新，并通过降低与过去行为不一致的评论的权重来减少信息不对称。一个实例演示说明了该方法如何为不同对象的评论分配可信度等级，以及这些等级如何补充总体评分统计信息。最后，一个广义理论已经（被提出）……
tldr: 本文将在线评论建模为序贯选择问题，基于双向一致性公理推导出取值于[0,1]区间的APCP度量，利用评论者的显示偏好历史量化评论可信度，从而支持信息更新并减少信息不对称。
en_tdlr: This paper models online reviews as a sequential choice problem and derives the Average Propensity to Choose a Pattern (APCP), a [0,1] measure built on a two-way consistency axiom, to quantify review trustworthiness from reviewers' revealed preference histories and thereby reduce information asymmetry.
